evidence.title: ChronoRealm Step 17B projected-model verification completed
evidence.summary: The original Step 17 TLA+ model was preserved as resource-exhausted/incomplete after disk exhaustion during state-space exploration. A separately named projected model, Step 17B, removed append-only history sequences while retaining the current-state variables and epistemic safety properties. TLC completed the projected model with no invariant violation: 322,545 distinct states at MaxSteps=8 and 531,441 distinct states at MaxSteps=12, with zero states left on queue in both runs. The projection itself is not claimed as proven; external adversarial review is being requested specifically for quotient/refinement soundness.
